title: Tide and Kitchen
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Rafael Pemberton, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
